description: Confirm a paid Lightning draft with its proof of payment: the 64-character preimage the paying wallet shows after a Lightning payment. Needed for drafts with a pasted bolt11 invoice, and for Lightning addresses whose provider does not report payments. send21 checks that SHA-256 of the preimage equals the invoice's payment hash; the draft then confirms within about 30 seconds. Requires scope drafts:write.
name: submit_lightning_proof
